units.source_text: 古歌：“青松千年寿，谁是此君俦？

en.t: An old poem says: The green pine lives for a thousand years, but who can be a companion to this noble one?

units.source_text: 可叹浮生短，情场不自由。”

en.t: How sad that fleeting human life is short, and in the realm of love one is not free.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu Rokucho.
